newsitem.title: RUSSIA: IMF-Russia tranches wait for high level talks - Tass.
newsitem.headline: IMF-Russia tranches wait for high level talks - Tass.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund can only approve the release of further tranches of its $10 billion loan to Russia after high level talks, Prime Tass news agency quoted the IMF Moscow mission head as saying on Tuesday.

Martin Gilman said that IMF fund director Michel Camdessus would come to Moscow on April 1 for talks with Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais. Camdessus may meet President Boris Yeltsin, he said.

The IMF has delayed payment of some tranches largely because of Russia's poor tax collection record, and Gilman said the IMF's board of directors could only approve further tranches of the three-year loan after high-level talks.
The IMF's regular monitoring mission arrives on Wednesday in Moscow to finalise talks on Russia's 1997 economic programme, Prime quoted Gilman as saying.
The 1997 economic plan, a key factor behind payments this year, will outline plans for structural reforms and set targets for the year.
